description: This file contains the implementation of the DirectLex class, a custom PHP-based HTML lexer used for tokenizing HTML content within the HTMLPurifier project. It includes methods for parsing HTML strings into tokens, handling comments, tags, attributes, and maintaining line number info.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DirectLex
classes.description: A pure PHP implementation of an HTML lexer that tokenizes HTML strings into a series of tokens, supporting features like line tracking, comment parsing, tag and attribute handling, and normalization.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Tokenizes an HTML string into an array of tokens, optionally normalizing the HTML, handling script tags with a callback, maintaining line numbers, and processing the HTML content into tokens.

methods.name: parseAttributeString
methods.description: Parses the inside of an HTML tag's attribute string into an associative array of attribute key-value pairs, handling quoted, unquoted, boolean attributes, and detecting malformed attributes.

methods.name: scriptCallback
methods.description: Callback used to process script content, escaping it into HTML entities to prevent execution issues.
